title: Turn the computer on and off
lines: This is a computer.
This is the power button.
Press the power button one time.
Wait. The screen turns on.
This is the desktop. The computer is ready.
To turn it off, click Start.
Click Power.
Then click Shut down.
Wait. The screen goes dark.
Do not pull the plug to turn it off.

title: Use the mouse
lines: This is a mouse.
Move the mouse. The arrow moves on the screen.
This is the left button.
Press the left button one time. This is a click.
Press it two times fast. This is a double-click.
A double-click opens things.
This is the right button.
A right-click opens a small menu.
Click an empty space to close the menu.

title: Use the keyboard
lines: This is the keyboard.
Click inside the page first.
Press a key to type a letter.
Press Backspace to delete a letter.
Hold Shift and press H for a big H.
Press the space bar to make a space.
Now type: I am Sam.
Press Enter to start a new line.
Good. You can type.

title: Open and close a window
lines: Each program opens in a window.
Double-click Notes to open it.
Look at the top right corner.
Click the line to hide the window.
Click Notes at the bottom to bring it back.
Click the box to make the window big.
Click the X to close the window.
The window is closed. You are back on the desktop.

title: Save your work
lines: Save your work so you do not lose it.
Click File at the top.
Click Save.
Type a name for your file: Work plan.
Pick a place to save it. Click Documents.
Click the Save button.
Look at the top. Now the file has a name.
Later, press Control and S to save again.

title: Make a folder
lines: A folder keeps your files together.
Right-click an empty space.
Click New.
Click Folder.
Type a name: Job Files.
Press Enter.
Double-click the folder to open it.
The folder is empty. It is ready for your files.

title: Put a folder inside a folder
lines: You can put a folder inside a folder.
Double-click Job Files to open it.
Click New folder at the top.
Type a name: Week 1.
Press Enter.
Double-click Week 1 to open it.
Look at the top. It shows Job Files, then Week 1.
Click Job Files to go back.

title: Write a short paragraph
lines: Double-click Notes to write.
Type one sentence.
Put a period at the end.
Press space. Type the next sentence.
A few sentences make a paragraph.
Made a mistake? Press Backspace to fix it.
Read it again. Then save it.

title: Write and send an email
lines: Double-click Mail to open it.
Click New email.
In To, type the email address.
In Subject, type what it is about.
Write your message in the big box.
Check the address again.
Click Send.
Your email is now in Sent.

title: Reply to an email
lines: A new email came in.
Click the email to read it.
Click Reply.
The address is filled in for you.
Type your answer.
Click Send.

title: Attach a file
lines: You can send a file with an email.
Click Attach. It means add a file.
Find your file. Click Work plan.
Click Open.
The file is now in your email.
Click Send.

title: Stay safe online
lines: Your password is a secret key.
Do not tell anyone your password.
Look at this email. It asks for your password.
This is not safe. Do not click the link.
Click Delete.
When you finish, click Sign out.
Not sure? Ask a staff member.

title: Search the web
lines: Double-click Browser to open it.
Click the search box.
Type what you want to find: bus times.
Press Enter.
Look at the results.
Click a result to open it.
Click the back arrow to go back.
